recent_trades.summary: Fully exiting NVDA position as AI slowdown calls from Amodei, Altman, and Musk represent a specific new negative catalyst for AI chip demand.

This is a direct headwind to NVDA's primary revenue driver (AI accelerator chips). The stock has been flat to declining for weeks. I previously trimmed from ~8% to ~5% on 9/10. The thesis has materially weakened with this new safety/slowdown narrative. Exiting now at -4.66% rather than risking further deterioration toward the -15% stop-loss. The $26B shareholder return is a positive sign but doesn't offset near-term demand uncertainty.
